authority_note: Producer (orchestrator) never verifies; directive-compliance-verifier owns verification rows. All D-047 requirements bind the non-ledger sentinel D-047-BOOTSTRAP (D-038..D-046 precedent; validator c5 forbids sentinel task_ids in task_verifications). This directive shapes EXECUTION (producer model + concurrency ceiling) of the D-045 campaign; individual campaign tasks verify through their own DCV rows. No completion claim exists at capture time.
